summary: SDK bundle: static keyword hits without corroborated exfiltration
details: Package is a Magda semantic indexer SDK shipped as a bundled dist/index.js. Static keyword scanners flagged the presence of POST method strings across the minified bundle and a single occurrence of the token 'dyndns' at line 44075. No specific installer-side data read is tied to any of these POST calls, no attacker-controlled destination is named, and no lifecycle scripts or import-time side effects were identified in the analyzed content. The 'dyndns' token appears as a substring within the minified bundle and is not linked to any traced network operation against a dynamic-DNS host. The pattern matches are consistent with a normal SDK bundle containing multiple HTTP client call sites rather than a hardcoded C2 channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
